item.description: Por MARK ANDERSON HENDERSON, Nevada, EE.UU. item.title: Women’s fight to vote gets musical treatment in ‘Suffs’
item.description: “Suffs” looks at the peak of the epic and heroic campaign to ratify the 19th amendment, which guaranteed women the right to vote in 1920 — it plays March 17-29 at the Emerson Colonial Theatre.
